Mumbai: Car hits and kills 8-year-old boy while driver is on phone

An 8-year-old boy was killed in Mumbai when a car, driven by a woman reportedly talking on her phone, struck him. The incident occurred while the boy's father was present, who described the child as his "only child" and "a piece of me." The driver was using an Innova Crysta vehicle. The boy died at the scene.
